about: Wording a public post must not contain. Each pattern is a regular expression, matched case-insensitively against every language of a news text after lower-casing, mapping the Uzbek apostrophes to ' and e-dieresis to e. The list is deliberately blunt: a false positive costs one rewording, a false negative is a public claim we cannot back. docs/news/README.md explains each rule.

rules.why: The only no-cost entry is a one-time welcome grant of 100 credits. Say that, never 'free'.
Every plan has a credit budget and concurrency limits.
Nothing about output quality, uptime or results is guaranteed.
'Best', 'fastest', 'number one' are comparisons we have not measured.
No promise of income, profit or getting rich.
No promise of views, reach, subscribers or going viral.
Absolute words ('forever', '100%', 'risk-free') are claims we cannot back.
Never imply that YouTube, Google, Telegram, Instagram or TikTok approves, certifies or partners with us.

provider_names.why: A model or provider may be named only after a real call through its adapter has succeeded (CLAUDE.md, Definition of Done). Until a human removes a name from this list in the same pull request that announces it, none may appear in a public text.
